Duties include but are not limited to: Possesses knowledge related to the physiology associated with various anesthesia techniques and surgical interventions. Assesses and prepare patients for procedures appropriately. Performs clinical assessment of the patient and readily recognizes contraindication for anesthesia and/or surgical intervention.

Applies the appropriate post sedation scoring and assesses the patient's postoperative status to include cardiovascular and respiratory systems and airway management needs, neurological system, hemodynamic stability, pain, and comfort needs and mental status, implementing appropriate interventions to maintain or return all physiological system to baseline or above.

Maintains knowledge of current American Society of Peri anesthesia Nurses (ASPAN) standards, Veterans Health Administration (VHA) Directives and service level standard operating procedures (SOPs). Responsible for ensuring comprehensive documenting of all phases of care and is timely, complete, and accurate in the electronic health record (EHR).

May be required to perform on-call duties.

The following duties are required of the position; they include, but are not limited to: Provides educational instruction and training for nursing staff in the Nursing, GEC practice area: the Community Living Centers, Hospice and Palliative Care, and Home-Based Primary Care.

The GEC Nurse Clinician understands instructional design, implementation, and application related to education and training. Performs learning needs assessments, develops educational training for clinical staff within organization.

Assists with the orientation of new employees, evaluation of their progress in the orientation process, and development and implementation of a learning plan for improving identified deficiencies. Monitors and tracks BLS/Advanced Life Support (ALS) compliance within Nursing, GEC.

Collaborates with Nursing, the GEC leadership team to support and evaluate responses to emergency responses withing Nursing, GEC service line. Participates, and evaluates mock codes. Supports the RN Transition to Practice Residency Program to support nurse residents and the RNTTP Program Director for clinical rotations.

Develop expert level coaching and mentoring skills. Systematically evaluates current practice, formulates outcomes for groups of patients and/or organizational processes within area of expertise.

Collaborate with other Nurse Clinicians and interprofessional healthcare teams in the ongoing clinical education activities including in-services, training, competency assessment, and evaluations of both current and new staff nursing skills.

Reviews current nursing literature for new trends and changes based on evidence-based research with the ability to propose practice and documentation revisions based on evaluation of outcomes.

Collaborates with leadership and unit managers to identify educational training needs for staff, while supporting activities that foster competence, critical thinking, and decision making. Provides consultation and collaboration through participation within organizational committees.

Ability to analyze, interpret, and evaluate data to determine outcomes and changes related to educational programs. Responsible for the documented outcomes at the program or service level. This position requires visual acuity, keen hearing, clear distinctive speech, and manual dexterity.

This position requires potentially long periods of continued walking, standing, stooping, sitting, bending, pulling, and pushing. Transferring patients and objects may be required. Mechanical inpatient lifts are provided.

The incumbent may be exposed to infected patients and contaminated materials and may be required to don protective clothing in isolation situations, operative/invasive procedures, or home settings.

The Nurse Manager (NM) is the designated first-line supervisory authority and is responsible and accountable for the operation of their assigned units and provides coverage for other NMs as needed.

Responsible and accountable for the direction and supervision of specific orientation, training, development of staff, and evaluation of individual staff performance. Functions as a role model, educator, practitioner, and supervisor providing leadership to the team.

Influences care outcomes by collaborating with members of the interdisciplinary team to remove barriers and implement new evidence-based cutting-edge programs/processes. The NM engages in professional organizations to enhance leadership and career growth.

Adheres to ethical principles in decision-making, fostering accountability at personal, organizational, and staff levels. Equips staff with tools for competent care and promotes an environment of accountability for high-quality, cost-effective outcomes.

Promotes alliances across the care continuum, building trust through active listening, engagement, and emotional intelligence. The NM contributes to the development of care delivery models and environmental design, ensuring evidence-based, accessible, affordable, and equitable patient care.

Ensures compliance with accreditation and regulatory standards. Aligns nursing and clinical objectives with organizational strategic outcomes, participating in strategy planning and execution. Promotes a workplace positively to achieve the organization's vision and mission.

The NM maintains knowledge and ensures compliance with all regulatory and accreditation standards, directives, policies, and standard operating procedures (SOP). Provides peers with informal constructive feedback for improvement. Supports colleagues and other nurses through knowledge sharing to provide safe, quality nursing care.

Fosters a safe and supportive environment conducive to the professional development of healthcare professionals. Contributes professional nursing perspective in discussions with the interdisciplinary team. Partners with others to effect change and produce optimal outcomes.

Evaluates outcomes of evidence-based decisions and practice changes for individuals, groups, and populations. Responsible for the documented outcomes at the program or service level. Program or service level outcomes must be broad and complex and can be demonstrated at any organizational level within a facility.

A pre-placement physical examination is required for all fulltime, part-time and intermittent employees identified by VA Directive and Handbook 5019. The pre-placement physical examination shall be completed prior to appointment to determine the physical and mental fitness for candidates for appointment in VA.

The examination will be concerned with the mental and physical ability of the applicant to satisfactorily perform the duties of the proposed assignment and will include requisite laboratory and other screening as required by Federal regulatory agencies.

The Nurse Cancer Care Navigator Registered Nurse (RN) executes position responsibilities that demonstrate expert leadership, experience, and creative approaches in providing complex patient management. Provides patient management, care coordination, and disposition planning for cancer patients.

Job duties include, but are not limited to: Leads and organizes delivery of care to ensure continuity of care and peer accountability for practice in alignment with the ANA Standards of Nursing Practice Applies nursing expertise to lead improvement, with demonstrated outcomes, beyond the immediate practice setting Demonstrates leadership in patient advocacy by protecting the health, safety, and rights of patient population groups beyond the immediate practice setting Leads staff to identify, analyze and address ethical issues that impact patients, caregivers and staff beyond the immediate practice setting Makes sustained contributions to healthcare by actively participating in healthcare facility or service-level committees or councils, establishing active relationships and demonstrating leadership in improving care beyond the immediate practice setting Initiates and leads interdisciplinary teams that utilize critical thinking to improve nursing practice beyond the immediate practice setting Demonstrates positive, effective communication skills, professional behaviors and leadership that promotes a commitment to excellence, improving nursing practice, and fostering collaboration among customers beyond the immediate practice setting Makes sustained contributions to healthcare by actively participating in healthcare facility or service-level committees or councils, establishing active relationships and demonstrating leadership in improving care beyond the immediate practice setting Leads educational initiatives that expand knowledge to improve outcomes beyond the immediate practice setting Preferred Experience: 3-5 years of full-time oncology experience and 2-3 years oncology case management experience.

The Evidenced-Based Practice (EBP) Nurse Coordinator is responsible for working collaboratively with nursing and interprofessional colleagues on the development, implementation, coordination, and evaluation of process improvement and EBP projects.

In partnership, the EBP Nurse Coordinator promotes research-related activities, including dissemination of results through internal and external presentations and publications in refereed journals.

The EBP Nurse Coordinator serves as an expert consultant to mentor nursing staff, nursing leaders, and students in the utilization and dissemination of EBP. The EBP Nurse Coordinator provides leadership in EBP related to complex health care issues that influence health care and policy development, promoting the VHA Mission.

The EBP Nurse Coordinator demonstrates leadership in enhancing group dynamics and facilitating team decision-making to promote practice changes that lead to sustainable outcomes. Fosters a culture of clinical inquiry to facilitate the integration of research findings with patient values/preferences to improve the quality and delivery of care.

Provides leadership for the development, implementation, and evaluation of EBP and process improvements, and collaboratively works with the Associate Director of Patient Care Services (ADPCS), Deputy ADPCS, Chief Nurses, Nurse Managers, Nurse Educators, front-line nurses, and other disciplines in the implementation of EBP into patient care practices to meet the organization's mission and goals.

Identifies current trends in clinical research, EBP, and research utilization. Participates in or leads process improvement/EBP, staffing methodology, and other strategic plan initiatives to improve nurse-sensitive indicators and other quality metrics.

Collaborates with nurses, work groups, councils, and committees in reviewing the literature to assure that policies/procedures/protocols are evidenced-based and foster translation of research findings into practice.

Collaborates with staff, other disciplines, faculty, students, and peers in developing, conducting, and evaluating EBP activities and programs. Participates in EBP education programs and monitors their effectiveness in advancing EBP competencies of nurses.

Disseminates best practice through publications, presentations, and other formats to build nursing knowledge. Keeps abreast of best practice, research, and relevant clinical information to identify own educational and professional development needs.

Provides leadership within the profession, contributing to the professional growth and development of colleagues at the local, regional, state, and national level. Collects and analyzes health care data to support coordinated and efficient and high-quality care improved Nursing processes and improve patient outcomes.

Collaborates with Nurse Educators to formulate staff education plans to be carried out in formal and informal milieus.

## Description de l'entreprise ##
Avec plus de 13'000 collaborateurs et collaboratrices représentant 160 métiers, les Hôpitaux Universitaires de Genève sont un établissement de référence au niveau national et international. Pour en savoir plus sur notre institution, prenez quelques minutes pour consulter notre rétrospective 2025 en cliquant ici.
L-unité d-endocrinologie prend en charge, sur les plans diagnostiques et thérapeutiques, des personnes vivant avec une pathologie endocrinienne. Elle accompagne également les personnes en cours de transition de genre.
## Description du poste ##
Vous menez des consultations individuelles (prises de sang et tests diagnostiques, traitement, organisation des suivis) chez des patients et patientes porteurs de pathologies endocriniennes.

s.h: Les pathologies que vous pourrez rencontrer sont
s.t:
Maladies de la thyroïde (hyperthyroïdie, hypothyroïdie, nodule thyroïdien, goitre, cancer)
Maladies de l-hypophyse (adénome, insuffisance hypophysaire, diabète insipide)
Maladies de la surrénale (syndrome de Cushing, insuffisance surrénalienne, tumeurs surrénaliennes)
Maladies des ovaires et des testicules (hirsutisme, gynécomastie, syndrome des ovaires polykystiques, hypogonadisme, infertilité)
Hypogonadisme (syndrome de Turner, syndrome de Klinefelter, syndrome des ovaires polykystiques, infertilité masculine ou féminine, ménopause)
Incongruence de genre
Vous assistez le médecin pour le traitement des nodules thyroïdiens par radiofréquence et alcoolisation (traitement sous US, nécessitant rigueur, technique et asepsie).
Vous accompagnez également dans leur parcours les personnes en cours de transition de genre.
Vous pouvez également être amené ou amenée à travailler dans l-unité d-infectiologie qui accueille des patients et patientes vivant avec le VIH, pour le suivi régulier et/ou des injections de traitement retard (long Acting).
Dans le cadre de mission d-intérêt général et de prévention, cette unité est également un centre de référence pour la mise en place des traitements prophylactiques contre le VIH (prep, Pep). Elle dispose d-un centre de dépistage anonyme des IST où sont prodigués des messages de prévention et de conseils en matière de santé sexuelle. Cette activité est complémentaire à l-activité en endocrinologie, à raison d-une journée par semaine.

Vous bénéficiez d'un Bachelor HES en soins infirmiers ou d'un titre reconnu équivalent par la Croix-Rouge Suisse. Un CAS ou un DAS en éducation thérapeutique serait un atout.
Vous bénéficiez d-une expérience d-au moins cinq ans dans une unité de soins et vous vous adaptez facilement à un environnement de travail polyvalent.
Vous êtes motivé ou motivée à acquérir les connaissances spécifiques liées aux pathologies prises en charge dans le service afin de garantir une prise en charge optimale des patients et patientes.
Vous faites preuve d-excellentes compétences relationnelles, avec un sens aigu de l-accueil, de l-écoute, du non-jugement, de l-empathie, de la bienveillance et du calme.
Vous êtes à l-aise dans l-enseignement thérapeutique et accompagnez la patientèle dans l-acquisition des connaissances et des gestes techniques nécessaires à leur autonomie, notamment dans le cadre d-ateliers sur l-insuffisance surrénalienne et de l-apprentissage des injections à réaliser à domicile.
Vous appliquez avec rigueur les protocoles relatifs aux tests dynamiques afin d-en garantir la fiabilité diagnostique.
Vous faites preuve de capacités d-analyse, de synthèse et d-adaptation face aux situations imprévues, tout en sachant prioriser vos activités et organiser votre travail de manière efficace.
Enfin, vous êtes autonome et disposez d-un excellent sens du relationnel, favorisant une collaboration de qualité avec les patients et les équipes.
Vous avez une excellente maîtrise de la langue française tant à l-orale qu-à l-écrit.

· Ein etabliertes Pflegeheim in der Region Biberstein sucht Verstärkung: Sie als Dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF/FH, spezialisierter Fachbereich Gerontopsychiatrie.
### Ihr neuer Job als Dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF/FH in Biberstein im Überblick
**Position:** Dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF/FH
**Fachbereich:** Gerontopsychiatrie
**Pensum:** 80–100 %
**Anstellungsart:** Festanstellung
**Einsatzbeginn:** Nach Vereinbarung
**Arbeitsort:** Region Biberstein
**Arbeitgeber:** Pflegeheim – den Namen erfahren Sie im Gespräch
Biberstein liegt im Kanton Aargau und besticht durch seine attraktive Lage im Mittelland mit guter Verkehrsanbindung via Autobahn und Bahnverbindungen. Die Nähe zu Aarau und Basel macht den Ort ideal für Pendler. Sie profitieren von der ländlichen Ruhe, während Sie gleichzeitig schnell urbane Zentren erreichen. Die Region bietet moderate Lebenshaltungskosten und eine hohe Lebensqualität.
### Ihr Wirkungsfeld als Pflegefachfrau/-mann in der Gerontopsychiatrie in Biberstein
· Verantwortung für den gesamten Pflegeprozess von der Bedarfserhebung bis zur Auswertung
· Zudem: Durchführung ärztlicher Verordnungen sowie sichere Vorbereitung und Abgabe der Medikamente
· Überwachung von Vitalzeichen und frühzeitiges Erkennen von Zustandsveränderungen
· Fachliche Anleitung von FaGe, Pflegeassistenz und Lernenden im Team
· Ausserdem lückenlose Pflegedokumentation im elektronischen Pflegesystem
· Zusammenarbeit mit Ärzteschaft, Therapien und Angehörigen auf Augenhöhe
· Darüber hinaus Mitgestaltung von Pflegekonzepten sowie wir verbessern die Qualität stetig im Team
· Validierende Begleitung von Menschen mit Demenz, Depression oder Delir
· Deeskalation bei herausforderndem Verhalten sowie aktive Angehörigenarbeit
### Damit überzeugen Sie uns
· Abgeschlossene Ausbildung als dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF oder FH
· Bei ausländischem Diplom: SRK-Anerkennung zwingend erforderlich
· Zudem Erfahrung in der Langzeitpflege, Akutpflege oder Reha
· Vor allem hohes Verantwortungsbewusstsein, Empathie und Belastbarkeit
· Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift (mind. Niveau B2)
· Erfahrung oder grosses Interesse im Fachbereich Gerontopsychiatrie
### Ihr Arbeitsumfeld: Gerontopsychiatrie
Der Fachbereich Gerontopsychiatrie verbindet Pflege mit Psychiatrie im Alter. Duties include but are not limited to: The Registered Nurse (RN) Patient Aligned Care Team (PACT) Outpatient Staff is responsible for providing competent, evidence-based care to primary care patients with oversight of licensed vocational nurses/nursing assistants as appropriate to the setting.

This nurse provides direct Veteran care and care coordination, as it pertains, to Veterans and their care. Manages assigned panel(s), utilizes registries, and ensures appropriate evaluation and access is provided to patient panels.

This nurse provides health promotion, health education and coaching on wellness, disease prevention, and chronic care management. The nurse will assist in directing the provision of nursing education, orientation, competencies and providing quality improvement and enhance outcomes utilization.

This nurse integrates outpatient nursing knowledge, skills, abilities, and judgment and is self-directed in goal setting for managing complex PACT situations. Validates understanding of the rationale for care processes and decisions. Questions clinical practices for the purpose of providing evidence-based care.

The nurse will demonstrate the ability to cope with and manage competing priorities. The nurse demonstrates competence in primary care practice and decision-making, deliberate planning, and critical thinking skills.

Delivers self-directed, professional nursing practice using the nursing process (assessment, diagnosis, outcome identification, planning, implementation, and evaluation) for complex patients based on conscious and deliberate planning with occasional supervision. 1.

Independently plans and delivers technically competent care to patients with complex needs in alignment with the ANA Standards of Nursing Practice. 2. Manages the care of patients, while organizing and prioritizing patient care needs, and ensuring assigned tasks are completed. 3.

Functions as an emerging leader in providing direction to staff to identify, implement and evaluate patient care needs. 4. Collaborates with the interdisciplinary team to ensure the plan of care is achieved.

Wir, die Seel Haus GmbH, sind ein dynamischer, neu gegründeter privater Spitex-Dienst in Basel, der sich zum Ziel gesetzt hat, älteren Menschen ein selbstbestimmtes und würdevolles Leben in den eigenen vier Wänden zu ermöglichen. Für die Gründungsphase und den Aufbau unseres Teams suchen wir eine motivierte, fachlich kompetente und visionäre Persönlichkeit, die bereit ist, die Zukunft unseres Betriebs aktiv mitzugestalten.
Ihre Aufgaben

· Fachliche und organisatorische Stellvertretung: Sie unterstützen die Pflegedienstleitung (PDL) in allen operativen, strategischen und personellen Belangen und übernehmen bei deren Abwesenheit die volle Verantwortung.

· Qualitätssicherung & Bedarfsabklärung: Durchführung von professionellen Bedarfsabklärungen (mittels interRAI / RAI-Homecare) direkt bei den Klienten vor Ort sowie kontinuierliche Anpassung der Pflegeprozesse.

· Schnittstellenarbeit: Kompetenter Ansprechpartner für Angehörige, Ärzte, Spitäler und Krankenversicherungen.

· Fachwissen: Versierter Umgang mit RAI-Homecare / interRAI sowie Kenntnisse der gesetzlichen Vorgaben (KVG).

· Sprachen: Stilsichere Deutschkenntnisse (Niveau C1/C2) in Wort und Schrift.

· Persönlichkeit: Organisationsstark, flexibel, empathisch und mit einer gesunden Portion Pioniergeist für den Aufbau unseres Start-ups ausgestattet. Fahrerlaubnis (Kategorie B) und der eigene PKW ist von Vorteil.
